events.title: Gate merges on ownership, required reviews, and checks
events.body:
## Outcome

Enforce repository-owned merge rules against the exact pull-request head before a protected ref changes.

## Implementation

- Define a signed, versioned merge-policy file for path ownership, required reviewers, approval counts, requested-change handling, and required workflow checks.
- Bind approvals and checks to the exact head object identifier and workflow digest; invalidate them after a patchset change.
- Resolve scoped maintainers through #447 and deterministic review state through #440.
- Use the same policy evaluator in desktop, browser, headless, and merge-queue paths.
- Allow a signed, reason-bearing, separately authorized override event that remains visible in history.

## Acceptance criteria

- Unowned paths, missing reviewers, requested changes, stale approvals, stale checks, and unknown policy versions fail closed.
- An accepted merge records the policy version, head, satisfied reviewers, and checks.
- Policy evaluation is identical in every client and under shuffled event arrival.
- A multi-ref protected update remains atomic.
- Overrides require an explicit role and cannot alter the stored policy.

## Dependencies

Depends on #437, #440, #447, #470, and #471; merge execution continues in #469.

## Verification

Run path-ownership, reviewer-count, requested-change, stale-head, stale-workflow, missing-check, scoped-role, invalid-policy, signed-override, and client-parity fixtures.
